# Advisories that govulncheck reports as reachable and that we have decided not
# to block the build on. Anything reachable and not listed here fails CI, so a
# new advisory -- the case this file exists for -- stops a pull request until
# somebody looks at it.
#
# Every entry needs a reason. An entry with a fix available is debt, not a
# decision: say where it is tracked so the line can be deleted rather than
# inherited. Regenerate with `make vulncheck-report` after any dependency or
# toolchain change, and delete what no longer appears.
#
# Baseline taken on release/v31 at e9f40f4, under the go1.25.8 toolchain that
# go.mod pins. The standard library set below moves whenever that directive
# does, which is the point: it is a running bill for staying behind.

# --- Go standard library ---------------------------------------------------
# go.mod pins go 1.25.8 and every one of these is fixed by go 1.25.13. They are
# a toolchain bump, not nineteen separate problems. Tracked in DO-487.
GO-2026-4865  # html/template, fixed in go1.25.9
GO-2026-4869  # archive/tar, fixed in go1.25.9
GO-2026-4870  # crypto/tls, fixed in go1.25.9
GO-2026-4918  # net/http, fixed in go1.25.10
GO-2026-4946  # crypto/x509, fixed in go1.25.9
GO-2026-4947  # crypto/x509, fixed in go1.25.9
GO-2026-4971  # net, fixed in go1.25.10
GO-2026-4980  # html/template, fixed in go1.25.10
GO-2026-4982  # html/template, fixed in go1.25.10
GO-2026-5026  # net/http, fixed in go1.25.13
GO-2026-5037  # crypto/x509, fixed in go1.25.11
GO-2026-5039  # net/textproto, fixed in go1.25.11
GO-2026-5856  # crypto/tls, fixed in go1.25.12
GO-2026-5972  # encoding/asn1, fixed in go1.25.13
GO-2026-6088  # encoding/xml, fixed in go1.25.13
GO-2026-6089  # net/http, fixed in go1.25.13
GO-2026-6090  # crypto/tls, fixed in go1.25.13
GO-2026-6091  # html/template, fixed in go1.25.13
GO-2026-6218  # net/url, fixed in go1.25.13

# --- Dependencies with a fix available -------------------------------------
GO-2026-5970  # golang.org/x/text v0.37.0, fixed in v0.39.0. Tracked in DO-487.
GO-2026-4508  # go-ethereum v1.16.9, fixed in v1.17.0. e2e only. The replace in
              # e2e_tests/go.mod documents why: v1.17.x drops trie/utils, which
              # cosmos/evm still imports. Reopens when cosmos/evm moves off it.

# --- No fix available ------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream has published no fixed version. Listed so the exposure is a recorded
# decision rather than a silent one.
GO-2023-1821  # cosmos-sdk x/crisis does not halt the chain. Informational
              # Cosmos advisory against a module we run with default params.
GO-2023-1881  # cosmos-sdk x/crisis does not charge ConstantFee. As above.
GO-2024-2584  # cosmos-sdk slashing evasion. No fixed version published.
GO-2026-4513  # shamaton/msgpack v2.4.1 denial of service. Transitive, reached
              # only through decoding paths that do not take untrusted input.
GO-2026-4740  # shamaton/msgpack v2.4.1 denial of service. As above.
GO-2026-5932  # golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained by design.
GO-2026-4883  # docker/docker v28.5.2. e2e only -- interchaintest drives local
              # containers in CI, not anything reachable from the chain.
GO-2026-4887  # docker/docker v28.5.2. As above.
GO-2025-3684  # cosmos/evm partial precompile state writes. e2e only, and the
              # advisory carries no symbol data, so govulncheck calls it
              # reachable on import alone. interchaintest imports only
              # cosmos/evm/crypto -- nothing from x/vm or the precompiles.
